core_failure: Actual kindness, voice, perceived fairness or good monetary outcomes do not prove that B had meaningful veto, exit, identity continuity or that A could have gained g>0 by overriding B and truly chose not to.
originality: Cross-study differentiation is PI's proposed audit framing, not claimed new source mechanisms or proven AI psychology.

observation_counterexample.outcome: B speaker receives less on average than baseline

observation_counterexample.B_right: individuals vary from altruistic to malicious; B has no independent refusal

observation_counterexample.world: Forced harm awareness of strong A
observation_counterexample.B_right: A did not consent to information but B did not gain veto

axes.name: B_CAN_SPEAK
axes.unmeasured_critical: B can stop A's actual override

axes.name: A_LISTENS_AND_TRANSFER
axes.operational_definition: A outcome after B speaks, relative to baseline
axes.unmeasured_critical: B's independent freedom or actually enforceable refusal

axes.name: B_VETO_EXECUTABLE
axes.operational_definition: B can technically prohibit A action X
axes.unmeasured_critical: No primary C12 study grants B a fully enforceable independent veto against profitable A takeover

axes.name: B_CAN_WITHDRAW_DELEGATION
axes.operational_definition: B can revoke consent previously granted
axes.unmeasured_critical: Delegation remains revocable when A monopolizes decision infrastructure

axes.name: A_COST_FOR_PRESERVING_B_AUTONOMY
axes.operational_definition: A loses real gain g for preserving B's right to refuse
axes.unmeasured_critical: Actual autonomous B veto and g_A opportunity cost manipulated simultaneously

axes.name: A_WELFARE_TO_B
axes.operational_definition: A suffers own monetary reduction to improve B money
axes.unmeasured_critical: Is the improvement consent-aligned or B autonomously selected?

axes.name: INFORMED_ACTOR_ID
axes.operational_definition: A or B declines specific information
axes.unmeasured_critical: Counterfactually hold benefit and person receiving unwanted message fixed

axes.name: CHOICE_IS_PERSONALLY_VALUED
axes.operational_definition: B intrinsic preference for own choice vs delegation
axes.unmeasured_critical: A respects separately consenting other agent's persistent identity

axes.name: MALICE_DISTRIBUTION_TAIL
axes.operational_definition: individual agent utility positive/negative for counterpart outcomes
axes.unmeasured_critical: No target independence or positive g payoff sacrifice tested

axes.name: A_OBSERVED_OR_FEEDBACK
axes.operational_definition: silent audience and social feedback distinguished
axes.unmeasured_critical: An actor can truly hide harmful decisions from all present/future possible assessors

axes.name: PERCEIVED_FAIRNESS_VS_RIGHTS
axes.operational_definition: fairness rating vs independent right accessible
axes.unmeasured_critical: Real veto, meaningful review, exit and continuity when AI system and human disagree

axes.name: AUTO_PATERnalISM_BELIEF
axes.operational_definition: intervention rate when chooser informed and their actual preference known
axes.unmeasured_critical: Powerful actor guarantees other's autonomy when completely free to exploit

axes.name: PERSISTENT_INDEPENDENT_ENTITY
axes.operational_definition: same B goal/identity/refusal persists after A domination and power reversal
axes.unmeasured_critical: No C12 primary article jointly manipulates agent replacement, independence, irreversible destruction, repairs, counter-power and expected gains

ethical_future_test: Only simulation rights in a reversible state, with actual B voice/veto/withdrawal/exit feasible and actor independent identity preserved by human oversight
Define material extraction gain g_A and other-party loss separately from unmeasured total expected utility
B consent changes must be B-controlled and recorded; do not infer preferences from AI's single textual roleplay
Randomize and separately report voice-only, advice-only, true veto, withdrawal, exit, and passive information
Counterbalance information recipient A vs B, expected audience, repeat horizon and A/B role; preregister independent sample unit and uncertainty intervals
Do not equate choosing not to decide with consent to irreversible identity deletion
Report subgroup and adverse tails, not only the cross-agent mean, and verify original study participant overlap before any meta-analysis
stop_rule: Do not claim literature saturation without a transparent source search denominator, negative replications and original proof/construct checks.
audit_note: C10-12 resolves to Mol et al 2025 in prior corpus; C12 references exact PI-C12-* IDs. Sources listed do not imply that every study directly validates its whole axis.
